product.title: Whitewater Rafting in Jackson Hole : Family Standard Raft

description.text: Experience the exhilaration of whitewater rafting on Wyoming's scenic rapids with our standard raft option. Perfect for larger families or those seeking stability, you'll tackle thrilling Class II and III rapids like the Big Kahuna and Lunch Counter. Transportation, safety gear, and local commentary are handled so you can focus on the landscape. Ideal for travelers basing in Jackson Hole who want a guided Wyoming outing without self-driving mountain roads.
